item.title: Omega Point
item.content:encoded:
Hi guys!

I have spent the last month writing and recording my own unique take on the SCP Foundation in the form of "Omega Point". The project takes 10 of my favourite skips and marries them to brutal death metal (with occasional splashes of doom metal, black metal, and other forms of extreme music.)

The first skip I read was SCP-610 and the absolute dread and horror I felt after concluding the story and not fully comprehending what the SCP Foundation was made me say "okay I need to do a project based on this". I then started planning the album around some of my favourite skips I read in the following weeks. (And yes, I commissioned SunnyClockwork to provide some killer artwork for the cover!)

You can check out the album below on my Bandcamp and in early January you can listen to it on Spotify, Deezer, Apple Music, etc. I can appreciate that brutal death metal might not be everyone's proverbial cup of tea, but I'd love to hear your input on this passion project of mine!

Big love

Richard <3

https://blackeneddeath.bandcamp.com/album/omega-point-1
